testNames: is refused once and keeps the ceiling copy, never reaching the refunded-start 409

ai.title: SDK treats session limit refusals as final
ai.summary: The SDK model provider in `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts` now classifies HTTP 409 responses with the `session_limit_reached` error code as final, non-retryable refusals. This prevents the AI SDK from retrying the request, which would otherwise refund the model purchase and cause subsequent retries to fail with `session_superseded` instead of displaying the ceiling message. The new fallback message is "Too many Freebuff tabs are running at once. Close another tab and try again."
ai.evidence: In `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`, a new entry for `session_limit_reached` is added to the `FINAL_REFUSALS` array, and the accompanying comment explains that this prevents the AI SDK from retrying 409 responses that trigger purchase refunds.

eli5.text: When too many browser tabs of the free coding assistant run at once, the system now shows a clear message telling you to close one and try again. Previously, the software kept trying to connect in the background, which caused a confusing error about a refunded purchase instead of the simple limit warning. This fix applies to anyone using the free tier who hits the maximum number of active sessions.

ai.title: Freebuff shortfall hint adapts when model picker is hidden
ai.summary: The shared `freebucksShortfallLine` helper in `common/src/util/freebuff-hours.ts` accepts a new `modelPickerHidden` flag to adjust its advice when a user's model picker is not visible. Previously, the helper always suggested picking a lower multiplier, which was inapplicable when the picker sat behind Advanced Mode. Now, when `modelPickerHidden` is true, the hint directs the user to enable Advanced Mode in Settings and General first, addressing a reported case where users had hours left but no way to switch models.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/util/freebuff-hours.ts`, the function `freebucksShortfallLine` gains an optional `modelPickerHidden` parameter; when true, the internal suggestion string switches from ' Pick a model with a lower multiplier to keep going.' to ' To keep going, turn on Advanced Mode in Settings → General and pick a model with a lower multiplier.', as verified by the new test 'without a visible picker the hint says where to find one'.

eli5.text: The assistant now tells you exactly where to find the model list when it is hidden behind advanced settings, rather than suggesting you pick a cheaper model from a menu you cannot see. This affects anyone using the free coding assistant who has some time left in their daily allowance but is unable to switch to a cheaper AI model. You will notice a clearer instruction to turn on the advanced settings panel before the assistant can start a new task.
